questions.stem: What is the role of oestrogen in the menstrual cycle?

options.text: It stimulates the development of follicles in the ovary
It causes the uterus lining to thicken and triggers the LH surge
It maintains the uterus lining after ovulation
It triggers menstruation at the end of the cycle

questions.explanation: Oestrogen is produced by the developing follicle. It causes the uterus lining to repair and thicken, and at high levels it inhibits FSH and stimulates a surge of LH, triggering ovulation.
